decisions.reason: As a launch highlighted on the home page and tightly tied to the firm's modular lighting systems and easy-installation promise, management is likely to stay committed unless a clear replacement is ready.

Although this LED luminaire was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, it sits close to the core lighting business in a growing market, so escalation of commitment still favors retaining it over admitting a weak launch.

The home automation server box extends the firm's control and smart-lighting offer and likely required meaningful development effort, which makes management inclined to justify and continue the product despite uncertainty.
A luminaire family with its own page suggests a visible and resource-intensive commitment in the firm's core premium category, so management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it quickly.
